CustomField.label: Integration Product Line
CustomField.description: Product2.Product_Line__c as text, so record-triggered Flows can filter and group Order Products by product line (a Flow's Get Records cannot filter on a related object's field). Used by the Salesforce -> Jira integration (Scenario 1, System Setup on Order activation) to decide which product line a setup request is for. Agreed with Swati Sharma, 5 Oct 2026. MuleSoft reads the same value through SOQL (Product2.Product_Line__c), never this field.
